commandArgs:
readonly SEARCH_PATHS_FILE="$1"
shift

readonly PARAM_FILE="$(mktemp)"
while IFS= read -r path; do
  if [ -d "$path" ]; then
    printf '%s
' "--extra-search-path" "$path" >> "$PARAM_FILE"
  fi
done < "$SEARCH_PATHS_FILE"

readonly TMP_OUT=$(mktemp)

if [ -f python_sample/ty_prototype/probe.py ]; then
  typed_wheel_found=0
  while IFS= read -r path; do
    if [ -f "$path/packaging/py.typed" ]; then
      for metadata in "$path"/packaging-*.dist-info/METADATA; do
        if [ -f "$metadata" ]; then
          echo "PROTOTYPE_SANDBOX_TYPED_WHEEL=$path" >&2
          typed_wheel_found=1
        fi
      done
    fi
  done < "$PARAM_FILE"
  test "$typed_wheel_found" -eq 1 || exit 97
  test -f python_sample/ty_prototype/stubs/ty_proto_stub.pyi || exit 98
  echo "PROTOTYPE_SANDBOX_STUB_PRESENT=yes" >&2
fi

bazel-out/remote_linux_x86_64_gnu_llvm-opt-exec/bin/tools/lint/ty_prototype_bin check --force-exclude --color always @"$PARAM_FILE" $@ > "$TMP_OUT" 2>&1
RET=$?

if [ "$RET" -eq 0 ]; then
    touch bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/python_sample/ty_prototype/ty_prototype.AspectRulesLintTy.out
else
    cp "$TMP_OUT" bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/python_sample/ty_prototype/ty_prototype.AspectRulesLintTy.out
fi

echo "$RET" > bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/python_sample/ty_prototype/ty_prototype.AspectRulesLintTy.out.exit_code
